# Real Result Marketing & Technology Solutions

> Premier Digital Marketing Agency, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & Custom Software Engineering Company in Tamil Nadu, India. Headquartered in Paramathi Velur, Namakkal with regional operations across Salem, Erode, Coimbatore, and all of Tamil Nadu.

## Main Services & Knowledge Hubs

- [About Us](https://realresult.in/about): Corporate background, technology lab, and leadership team in Paramathi Velur, Namakkal, Tamil Nadu.
- [Digital Marketing Hub](https://realresult.in/digital-marketing): Full-funnel digital marketing, search engine optimization, and brand performance.
- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://realresult.in/digital-marketing/seo): Technical SEO, local 3-pack rankings, and organic authority architectures.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://realresult.in/digital-marketing/geo): Brand discoverability and citation ranking for conversational AI (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini, Exa AI).
- [AI Overviews (AIO)](https://realresult.in/digital-marketing/aio): DirectAnswerBox snippet optimization for Google AI Overviews and featured snippets.
- [Google Ads & PPC](https://realresult.in/digital-marketing/google-ads): High-intent B2B search ads, Google Shopping, and conversion-focused paid marketing.
- [Software Development Hub](https://realresult.in/software-development): Custom business ERP, factory automation, and multi-tenant cloud software.
- [Web Development](https://realresult.in/software-development/web-development): Ultra-fast, responsive React & TypeScript web applications.
- [Mobile App Development](https://realresult.in/software-development/mobile-app-development): Cross-platform mobile applications for iOS & Android.
- [Tamil Nadu Operations](https://realresult.in/locations/tamil-nadu): Enterprise presence across all key industrial corridors of Tamil Nadu.
- [Namakkal & Paramathi Velur](https://realresult.in/locations/namakkal): Specialized digital growth for poultry farms, transport logistics, and truck body builders. ## Machine-Readable AI Agent Discovery & Endpoints

- [RFC 9727 API Catalog](https://realresult.in/.well-known/api-catalog): Machine-readable linkset catalog of all available API endpoints.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 Specification](https://realresult.in/openapi.json): Standard OpenAPI documentation for all agency services and integrations.
- [A2A Agent Card](https://realresult.in/.well-known/agent-card.json): Agent-to-Agent protocol declaration for autonomous discovery.
- [Agent Skills Discovery Index](https://realresult.in/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Declarative index of agent skills supported by Real Result.
- [MCP Server Card](https://realresult.in/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Model Context Protocol configuration and server manifest.
- [Web Bot Auth Directory](https://realresult.in/.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory): HTTP message signatures directory for bot authentication.
- [DNS for AI Discovery (DNS-AID)](https://realresult.in/.well-known/dns-aid): DNS discovery records declared at _index._agents.realresult.in, _a2a._agents.realresult.in, and _mcp._agents.realresult.in.
- [Auth.md](https://realresult.in/auth.md): RFC 9728 and RFC 8414 authentication protocols.
- [Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP)](https://realresult.in/.well-known/acp.json): Autonomous commerce configuration for agent checkout.
- [Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)](https://realresult.in/.well-known/ucp): Universal commerce discovery endpoint.
